title: When to Take Shilajit for Optimal Energy Boosts
abstract:
## Morning (Empty or Nearly Empty Stomach)  
- **Best for absorption**: Taking shilajit first thing in the morning, before eating or with a light meal, may improve how your body absorbs its active compounds.
- **Sustained energy**: Since shilajit’s effects can last up to 14 hours, morning use may help maintain energy and focus throughout the day.
## Before Exercise  
- Anecdotal reports suggest taking shilajit 30 to 45 minutes before workouts may support stamina and endurance. Some users also split their dose taking part before a workout and the rest afterward to aid recovery.
- While scientific studies are limited in this area, shilajit’s role in mitochondrial function suggests it could help your body produce energy more efficiently during physical activity.
## How Much Shilajit Should You Take?  
Most clinical studies have used doses between 250–1,000 mg per day. Ayurvedic guidance typically suggests 300–500 mg daily for general wellness.  
Shilajit is slow-metabolizing and may reach peak levels in the bloodstream 12 to 14 hours after consumption. This may explain why early morning dosing offers the longest-lasting impact on energy levels.  
Always follow the dosing instructions provided on the product label, and talk to your healthcare provider for personalized advice especially if you're new to herbal supplements.
